About & Diagnostics

Developer Mode: Sport Templates

Define the field, markings, goals, and formation rules for a new sport. Templates save locally and export/import as JSON.
Activating swaps the field geometry and markings on the real board. Player counts, formations, and Practice Studio still assume water polo -- that generalization is a later stage. Use "Restore Water Polo" to go back at any time.

Shortcuts

Keyboard:
⌘C copy · ⌘V paste · ⌘D duplicate · ⌘Z undo · ⌘⇧Z redo · Delete remove · Space play/stop · H highlight · A pass arrow · N note · G ghost · Shift+L/R ball hand

On iPhone/iPad: use the Copy, Paste, Delete Selected, and Ball → Left/Right Hand buttons above. Turn on Multi-Select to tap several items, or drag an empty area to box-select. Hold a player or the ball to open its menu (duplicate, rotate, give ball, left/right arm, no block, lock, hide...).

How to Use New Tools

Team Manager: Edit the name and role fields directly. This list refreshes automatically whenever you duplicate, delete, or paste a player.

Smart Ball Passing: Give the ball to a player, click Pass Arrow, then click another player. The tool draws the pass and moves ball ownership to the target player's right hand.

Snap Toggle: When Snap is On, dragged players/ball snap close to key field lines: 2m, 5m, 6m, 12.5m, 19m, 20m, 23m and center width.

Ghost Mode: Turn it on, create/update frames, then move to the next frame. The previous frame remains faded behind the current frame.

Categories: Tap a category above to open its full tool list. The "Most Used" row at the top always shows your 3 most-used tools overall, across every category, for quick access.

Version History

Autosaves in the background as you work. Save a named checkpoint before trying something risky, and restore it later if needed.

Recovery

The app always reopens exactly where you left off. If that's not the session you wanted, restore one of the last 3 sessions here -- captured automatically whenever you closed or switched away from a session, not just every few seconds.

Tactical Packages

"Export Everything" downloads every saved formation, tactical package, and practice session into one file. Each saved formation and package below also has its own \u2913 Export button, for sharing just that one item -- Import accepts either kind of file. To use this on another device: save the exported file into a folder synced by iCloud Drive or Google Drive, then open this app on the other device and use Import to pick that same file.

Presentation Studio

Build an ordered playlist of saved formations and packages, then present it slide-by-slide with one-touch Prev/Next -- no need to open panels mid-meeting.
Saved Presentations

Object Engine (Scene JSON)

Exports every object currently on the board (players, ball, drawings) using the canonical Tactical Engine object schema — the same schema future Practice Studio / Match Studio / AI Coach features will read and write.
